name: Wand of Paralysis

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Paralyzing Ray
powers.text: Magic action, 1 charge: a thin blue ray at a creature within 60 ft: a DC 15 Con save or Paralyzed for 1 minute (save again at the end of each of its turns).

summary: 7 charges: a ray that Paralyzes a creature for up to a minute (Con DC 15).
text: As a Magic action, spend 1 of its 7 charges and a thin blue ray shoots from the tip at a creature you can see up to 60 feet away. The target must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 15) or be Paralyzed for 1 minute; after each of its turns it gets a new save, breaking free on a success. The wand recovers 1d6 + 1 charges each dawn; spending the last one forces a 1d20 roll, and on a 1 it crumbles to ash and is destroyed.
